_comment: Characterize each stack at 3 load REGIMES anchored on its measured breaking point: max tenable / rupture / rupture x2 (shop capped at 30k, not 40k, to stay feasible on the load host). Under constant/step/peak. Replicas = exactly those used when the breaking point was measured (v4=8, v5=8+2+2, shop=1/service since gRPC pinning makes multi-replica ineffective). stop_on_break=false: rupture x2 is intentionally beyond the break. Per-infra spawn_rate (shop needs a high spawn to reach 20k-30k).
